sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: Alan Turing influenced John McCarthy in 1950. John McCarthy founded AI Laboratory in 1956. The Dartmouth Conference occurred in 1956.

sections.heading: Timeline
sections.content: The French Revolution began in 1789. The National Convention founded a new republican government in 1792. The Reign of Terror occurred in 1793.

sections.heading: Core Model
sections.content: Alfred Wegener influenced Harry Hess in 1962. Harry Hess founded Seafloor Spreading Theory in 1962. Plate Tectonics related to Continental Drift and modern geology.

sections.heading: Development
sections.content: Tim Berners Lee founded World Wide Web in 1989. World Wide Web related to Hypertext Transfer Protocol in 1991. Cern Laboratory influenced Internet Technology in 1991.

sections.heading: Cultural Movement
sections.content: Harlem Renaissance occurred in 1920. Langston Hughes influenced Zora Neale Hurston in 1925. Apollo Theater related to African American Culture in 1934.

sections.heading: Definition
sections.content: Bayes theorem describes how prior belief is updated with new evidence. Thomas Bayes influenced probability theory and Bayesian inference. Bayesian reasoning is related to decision theory.
